sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Why today of all days? My alarm worked! I know it did!
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on, don't do this to me!
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously... I stopped to read that creepy note, and now my pass is gone?
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: I'm late, I'm cardless, and I'm trying very hard not to become a tragedy in a school uniform.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. That's not a normal sentence.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Did my friends put you up to this? Because this prank is way too elaborate for eight in the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: That made it worse. You know that, right?
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: People do not just vanish before homeroom!
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Aah— school! Mystery later, attendance first!
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Seat by the window, huh... If that's true, who were you?
sprite_sequence.label: surprise
